criteria.statement: When the verify-functional workflow's inner loop exits with no build defect left, or at its iteration cap, and a Debug pass in this invocation changed files or criteria are awaiting regression, the workflow runs one regression pass (an Exercise and a Judge) before it returns, in place of the old `confirmAwaiting` step
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 73-79 ("`confirmAwaiting` is replaced by a regression pass at exit"); §Decision lines 104-106
criteria.evidence: Jest run of `verify-functional.test.js` cases for both exits (satisfied, and cap reached) whose stubbed agent log shows an Exercise and a Judge dispatched after the last inner-loop iteration, and whose workflow result carries a `regression` entry for round 1; test output naming the passing cases

criteria.statement: A settled-met criterion whose covered file appears in the `filesChanged` of a Debug pass at an iteration greater than or equal to its `provenAt` is re-exercised and re-judged by the regression pass
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 70-77; line 74 incorporates scope (a) of line 27
criteria.evidence: Jest case: criterion met at iteration 1, Debug at iteration 1 or later returns `filesChanged` containing one of its covered paths; the regression round's Exercise and Judge prompts both name that criterion id, and the round's scope lists it with reason "covers changed"

criteria.statement: Every member of a cause the inner loop fixed, still marked `awaiting: "regression"`, is re-exercised and re-judged by the regression pass
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 45-49, 73-74; §Decision lines 104-106 ("keep its guarantees"); line 74 incorporates scope (b) of line 27
criteria.evidence: Jest case with a closed cause holding non-representative members; the regression round's Exercise and Judge prompts name every awaiting member, and its scope lists each with reason "cause member"

criteria.statement: A settled-met criterion that has no entry in `criterionCovers` is re-exercised and re-judged by the regression pass whenever a regression pass runs
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 67-69 (covers derived only "for every criterion that maps"), line 74 incorporates scope (c) of line 27
criteria.evidence: Jest case where one met criterion is absent from `criterionCovers` and a Debug pass changed an unrelated file; the regression round's prompts name it and its scope lists it with reason "no covers"

criteria.statement: When a Debug pass returned nothing, or returned no `filesChanged` array, its changed files are treated as unknown, and every settled-met criterion proven at or before that pass's iteration is in the regression pass's scope
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 70-72, 76-77; §Decision lines 95-98 ("a missing return widens scope, never narrows it")
criteria.evidence: Jest case: Debug stub returns no `filesChanged`; the recorded Debug history shows `files: null` for that iteration, and the regression round's scope includes every criterion met at or before it

criteria.statement: A settled-met criterion none of whose covered files changed after its `provenAt` is neither re-exercised nor re-judged by the regression pass, and its verdict, artifact and `provenAt` in `verification-state.json` are byte-for-byte what they were before the pass
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 73-77; §Decision lines 93-94 ("Scope by changed files, not a re-run of everything")
criteria.evidence: Jest case with two met criteria, one whose covers changed and one whose covers did not; the regression round's Exercise and Judge prompts do not contain the untouched id, and the state file's entry for it keeps the earlier iteration's `status`, `artifact` and `provenAt`

criteria.statement: When no Debug pass in this invocation changed anything and nothing is awaiting regression, no regression pass runs: no Exercise or Judge is dispatched after the inner loop exits
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 77-79 ("a run satisfied first time costs nothing extra")
criteria.evidence: Jest case satisfied on iteration 1 with no Debug pass; stubbed agent log shows exactly one Exercise and one Judge in total, and the result's `regression` field records no round

criteria.statement: No regression pass runs when the loop exits `unbuilt` or `setup-failure`
criteria.evidence: Jest cases for each of the two exits; agent log shows no Exercise or Judge after the exit iteration

criteria.statement: A criterion met in an early iteration whose covered file a later Debug edit changes, and which that edit broke, is ruled `not_met` with kind `build-defect` by the regression pass, receives a cause key and joins the cause map, rather than being left `met`
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 41-44 (today's carried-forward `met` is never re-checked), 80-82 ("A regressed criterion (now a build defect) gets a cause key and joins the cause map")
criteria.evidence: Jest case: criterion met at iteration 1, Debug at iteration 2 changes its covered file, regression Judge stub rules it `not_met` / `judged-failed`; final state file shows it `not_met` with a `causeKey`, and the result's regression round lists it as caught. Optionally also the headless fixture run in FS-19

criteria.statement: A criterion the regression pass re-checks and rules `met` settles again with the regression pass's `provenAt` and a `regression` round marker (1 or 2), not the earlier iteration's
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 80-81; §Open Questions line 151 (OQ-2: both passes keep the exit iteration's number and carry `regression: 1 | 2`)
criteria.evidence: `verification-state.json` from a Jest case: the re-checked criterion's entry carries `provenAt` equal to the exit iteration and `regression: 1`; its exercised-history entry carries the same round marker

criteria.statement: For every criterion the regression pass re-checked, the verdict, artifact and `provenAt` recorded in `verification-state.json` and in the report are the regression pass's own
criteria.evidence: Jest case with a criterion first met at iteration 1 and re-checked: the state file's entry and the rendered report row both show the artifact path the regression Exercise claimed and the regression Judge's status, and neither shows the iteration-1 artifact

criteria.statement: Custody (`packages/core/lib/custody.js`), given a state file written after a regression pass, reads each re-checked criterion's status and artifact from the regression pass's entry
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 60-63; §Decision lines 107-108 ("a custody test pins that it reads the regression pass's entries"); §Open Questions line 150
criteria.evidence: Jest run of `custody.test.js` with the regression-pass state case: output showing custody's affected-id or reconcile result uses the regression pass's status and artifact for the re-checked id

criteria.statement: Build defects the regression pass surfaces go to exactly one further Debug round, outside the iteration cap, and that round is handed only causes holding a regressed or awaiting criterion
criteria.evidence: Jest case where the round-1 regression Judge rules one criterion `not_met` / `build-defect`: agent log shows exactly one Debug dispatch after round 1, and its prompt names only causes containing a regressed or awaiting id

criteria.statement: After that one Debug round, at most one more regression pass runs, scoped against that Debug's `filesChanged` plus the ids it was sent; its ruling is final, and no third pass and no further Debug follow, whatever it rules
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 84-86 ("The second pass's action is final")
criteria.evidence: Jest case where the round-2 regression Judge still rules a criterion `not_met`: agent log shows exactly two regression rounds and no Debug after round 2; the result's `regression` field has rounds 1 and 2 only

criteria.statement: Evidence gaps and not-checkable results the regression pass produces are recorded in the state file with their kind and reason and are not sent to Debug or re-walked
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 83-84 (only regressed build defects go to Debug); line 32 records the PM's wording
criteria.evidence: Jest case where the regression Judge rules one criterion `evidence-missing` and one `not_verifiable` / `capability-absent`: state file shows both with `kind` and reason, and no Debug or further Exercise names either id

criteria.statement: Each regression pass's Judge runs with decide-next's `cap` equal to the iteration so it cannot start remediation, and the full-deploy gate (`computeFinalRun`, `FULL_RUN_COMMAND`) is not re-run: the exit iteration's gate result is copied to the result unchanged
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 58-59, 85-86; §Decision lines 104-105 ("No gate re-run (the exit's result is copied), decide-next cannot remediate")
criteria.evidence: Jest case with a `FULL_RUN_COMMAND` declared: the final result's gate result equals the exit iteration's, and the regression Judge prompt does not ask for the gate to be run

criteria.statement: When criteria still fail after the final regression pass, the run's `exit-stuck` reason names each failing criterion and does not claim the iteration cap was reached when it was not
criteria.cites: §Decision lines 104-106 ("the false 'iteration cap (N)' wording is corrected, and an `exit-stuck` names members still failing")
criteria.evidence: Jest case satisfied before the cap whose regression pass catches a criterion: the exit reason string contains that criterion's id and does not contain "iteration cap"

criteria.statement: The verification report has a "Regression pass" section showing, per round, each criterion re-checked with its reason (covers changed, cause member, or no covers), which were caught as broken, and the settled-met criteria that were not re-walked
criteria.evidence: Rendered report markdown from a Jest case (or from the FS-19 fixture run) containing the "Regression pass" heading, a re-checked id with its reason, a caught id, and an untouched met id listed as not re-walked

criteria.statement: In a headless fixture run where the fix for one cause breaks a criterion met earlier, the report shows the regression pass catching that criterion while untouched met criteria are not re-walked
criteria.cites: line 35 (the PM's acceptance wording); `.claude/rules/verification.md` §1 `fixtures` environment authorizes headless sessions
criteria.evidence: Report and `verification-state.json` from a headless `claude --print` run in a fixture slot: the "Regression pass" section lists the broken criterion as caught, and the untouched met criteria appear only in its not-re-walked list
